case.title: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear colleagues at Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH,

Thank you for your message.

Our cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010).
Your quality was 270 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70410@2026Q3).
Our orders of Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM with you were placed at EUR 29.89 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011517-10), EUR 29.89 on 2025-05-19 (po:4500012472-10), EUR 29.89 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013451-10) and EUR 29.89 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014436-10): the price has been unchanged.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 28.29; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 36 months; lead time 42 days.
Binding volume in every option: 23,400 units a year over 36 months.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the quality record data and the price history data you cited; both hold, but they do not change our calculation. We also checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Your cost estimate and historical prices are noted; however, our pricing is determined by current market conditions and our high capacity utilisation. Our price reflects our costs, and our calculation stays internal as it is our property; we do not share a breakdown. We meet the agreed quality targets. We accept the proposed volume of 23,400 units and the 36-month contract term.

This is our letztes Angebot. Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Our main proposal is a price of €33.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.

Alternatively, to provide a reduced unit price of EUR 31.60, we must maintain the lead time at 54 days. We offer a price of €31.60 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

We can accept your terms and await your order. We accept your proposal of EUR 31.60 per unit with a lead time of 56 days, a volume of 23,400 units per year, and a 36-month contract term. 

This concludes our negotiation. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
